overview_text: The artificial intelligence and business administration combined major integrates a technical degree with the theory and practice of management through active learning, problem-driven research, corporate partnerships, and experiential assignments. Students study the collection, manipulation, storage, retrieval, and computational analysis of data in its various forms, including numeric, textual, image, and video data from small to large volumes. This program reflects the impact of data and machine learning in modern business practice.
